svg.title: Writing ആ
svg.desc: 5 frames; frame N shows movements 1 to N of ആ (malayalam), the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansMalayalam-Static.ttf. Stroke order after Sriveenkat, Ml ആ order.gif, stroke-order animation of Malayalam independent vowel ആ in Gayathri, 73 frames, 11 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 1 June 2023) <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ml_%E0%B4%86_order.gif>. Source note on variation: The CC BY-SA 4.0 animation draws the left outer arch in frames 2–9, then begins a disconnected second run at frame 10; every later frame joins the existing ink as the inner curl flows through the lower loop, central upright, rounded right loop, and below-line finish. The path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Malayalam outline rather than the source's Gayathri proportions, preserving the one-lift order while allowing arch width, loop roundness, and descender depth to vary.
